data.name: Yurik
data.gender_notes: Yurik is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Slavic name Jurij, meaning 'lord, master, ruler'. This name was borne by St. George of Amastrid, a 4th-century martyr whose feast day is celebrated on April 30th. The name Yurik carries the meaning “Power, rule” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Yurik usually hope their child will grow to embody power, rule and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Yurik belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Power, rule.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yurik total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

Historically, the name has been borne by numerous rulers, saints, and heroes in Eastern Europe. In contemporary times, it continues to be a popular given name in various Orthodox Christian communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Yurik" is a reminder of the Christian virtues of leadership, strength, and courage, inspired by the legacy of St. George, the patron saint of the name. It encourages those who bear the name to strive for personal growth and to serve as leaders and role models in their families, communities, and the world at large. Additionally, the name carries the spiritual significance of Faith and Martyrdom in the face of adversity, which St. George exemplified so profoundly.
